subject: midi.import_file against the MIDI file Open panel on an Intel Mac
question: record_sequence failed at midi.import_file on every attempt with Accessibility and Automation granted. Which stage of the import script fails, and why?

reverify.command: On an Intel Mac with Logic 12.4, open a project and call logic_tracks record_sequence {notes: "60,0,500,100"} on the release binary of main b49663f8, then on this branch.
reverify.expected: main fails with DIALOG_NOT_FOUND (go-to-folder field did not accept the path) and, once the path stage is passed, IMPORT_BTN_ERROR (panel appeared but exposed no commit button); this branch reaches the tempo prompt and creates the lane.

method: The failing call was traced with logic_system get_trace, then each stage of the import script was reproduced by hand through System Events against the same Logic session: open the panel from the menu bar, send the go-to key after a delay, walk the panel's windows, sheets and buttons, set the path field, and close the panel with Escape. Each code change was then rebuilt and re-run through the MCP tool.

observations.trace: one AppleScript segment of 18834 ms, then import_failure
observations.error: DIALOG_NOT_FOUND: go-to-folder field did not accept the path
observations.note: 18.8 s is the 15 s path budget plus the earlier stages: the go-to sheet never opened

observations.probe: panel opened from the menu bar, go-to key sent after 2.0 s
observations.windows: one AXDialog with 0 sheets, then 1 AXSheet holding 1 AXTextField
observations.note: the topology the script expects; the only difference from the script is the 2.0 s wait before the key

observations.probe: set value of that text field to a directory path, read back after 0.5 s and 1.5 s
observations.result: both reads return the path unchanged
observations.note: assignment works; the field is not the problem

observations.conclusion_of_probes: the key sent about 0.35 s after the panel appears is dropped while the panel loads
observations.change: re-send it at most once a second while the dialog has no sheet

observations.error: IMPORT_BTN_ERROR: the Import panel appeared but exposed no Import button

observations.probe: buttons of the AXDialog itself, and buttons of each of its UI elements
observations.note: both script walks read only UI element 1; the cancel and commit buttons are direct children of the dialog

observations.result: region imported, track count 1 -> 2, tempo prompt seen and declined
observations.note: the import itself now completes; the GM Device downgrade is a separate record

conclusion: On this host two timing/topology assumptions in the import script fail: the go-to key is lost when sent before the Open panel accepts input, and the panel's buttons are its direct children rather than children of its first element. Re-sending the key only while no sheet exists, and walking the dialog's own buttons in the fallback, makes the import complete.
limits: Measured on one Intel Mac (Logic 12.4 build 6707, macOS 15.7.4, en-US). Apple Silicon and other macOS versions were not measured here.
The primary button walk is left unchanged, so hosts where it already worked keep their path; the fallback change is only exercised when the primary walk finds nothing.
No unit test drives the AppleScript itself; the evidence is the live run above.

canon_not_applicable.reason: This record states a fact about Logic's BEHAVIOUR -- when the MIDI file Open panel accepts a key, where its buttons sit in the AX tree, what kind of lane an import creates -- not about a string Logic ships. There is no key to cite and nothing to prove absent. Rule 13 checks the claim: if any reading here resolved in the corpus the declaration would be refused.
